newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Memtec jumps after merger terminated.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Memtec jumps after merger terminated.

text.p: The shares of water filtration equipment maker Memtec Ltd rose sharply after the company's planned merger with U.S.-based Gelman Sciences Inc was terminated after Gelman agreed to merge with another company.
At 1.10 p.m. (0210 GMT), Memtec shares were A$5.50 or 15.7 percent higher at A$40.50.
"The stock is rallying in relief the merger did not take place. It's basically returning to levels it was at before the merger was announced," one Sydney-based dealer said.
On Monday, Pall Corp said it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Gelman, which it said ended Gelman's merger pact with Memtec.
Memtec had been offering 1.5 of its shares for each Gelman share which valued Gelman at about US$280 million.
In a statement to the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX), Memtec said it believed its offer for Gelman was full and fair and it was not prepared to increase its offer.
